lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 (CAM-265 review round 1) fixed the CRITICAL Layer B finding on US-001's AC6: the oracle `test -z "$(git diff --name-only main -- src/)"` was jointly unsatisfiable with AC7 (embed-vendor:check must pass) because regenerating the embedded vendor bundle necessarily touches `src/vendor/_generated.ts`. Re-scoped the AC6 text and oracle to explicitly exclude that generated file via git pathspec exclusion: `git diff --name-only main -- src/ ':!src/vendor/_generated.ts'`. Verified empty output against the current branch diff (which does modify src/vendor/_generated.ts from US-001). No source code changed; this was a PRD-text amendment only. All quality gates green: typecheck, bun test (4400 pass / 0 fail), bun run check:all (lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/embed-vendor all ok).
